mapper.select: select m.id, a.id as accountId, a.login_id, a.password, c.id as classroomId, c.name as classroomName, c.classroom_number, m.first_name, m.last_name from managers as m left join accounts as a on a.id = m.account_id left join classrooms as c on c.id = m.classroom_id where m.id = #{managerId}
mapper.insert: insert into managers (account_id, classroom_id, first_name, last_name) values (#{accountId}, #{classroomId}, #{firstName}, #{lastName})
mapper.update: update managers set classroom_id = #{classroomId}, first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName} where id = #{id}
